verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, a CRUD API for performing any action available on console.statsig.com without the web UI. A separate HTTP API retrieves gate, experiment, and config values and logs events without an SDK, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), any evidence on API auth, keys, or rate limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
